changelog:
Initial release of weibo-hot-with-your-taste.

- Fetches and customizes trending Weibo topics based on user preferences.
- Supports interactive preference setup and fine-tuning via structured interviews.
- Enables real-time push feedback and self-adapts taste rules.
- Includes feedback workflows for rating pushes and addressing incomplete info.
- Provides data structure and script breakdown for initialization, fetching, pushing, feedback, and surveys.
- Integrates clear setup and credential configuration instructions.
